title: RTP Player: Added ability to save streams as .au and .wav
description:
Features:
- saves multiple streams (all selected and unmuted)
- saves streams same way they are played (jitter buffer, sampling, ...)
- only streams with audio (play rate >0) are exported
  - streams with play rate == 0 are silently ignored even selected for
    export
- all exported streams must use same play rate (user can change it
  before save)

Windows/MSVC compile error:

    ui\qt\rtp_player_dialog.cpp(1917,39): warning C4267: '=': conversion from 'size_t' to 'gint16', possible loss of data

You should probably change

    data16 = channels * sizeof(SAMPLE);

to something that 1) makes sure that `channels * sizeof(SAMPLE)` fits in 16 bits and 2) fails (returning -1) if it doesn't and casts it to `guint16` before assigning it to `data16` if it does.

It is in place where I just pushing data to 16 bits. channels is small int (up to a few tens or hundreds), sizeof(SAMPLE) is 2. Therefore overflow will never happen.
I will adapt code to pass compilation...
